title: pellaea hastata
intro: Pellaea hastata, commonly known as the Lance-leaf fern or Needle fern, is a species of fern in the family Pteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant.
